#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    
    int result = 1;
    int current = m;
    
    while (current != 0) {
        int remainder = current % w;
        if (remainder == w - 1 && remainder != 1) {
            current = (current + 1) / w;
        } else if (remainder == 1) {
            current /= w;
        } else if (remainder != 0) {
            result = 0;
            break;
        } else {
            current /= w;
        }
    }
    
    cout << (result == 1 ? "YES" : "NO");
    
    return 0;
}
